title: Tensorized embedding domain Mirror views
hypothesis: A shared Tensor-Train embedding bank with a low-description Mirror view on one core can express multiple domain-specific embedding tables using fewer bytes than independent domain cores, while preserving held-out token lookups; generic PCA is the control.
physical_object: shared TT embedding cores representing 256x256 tables with rank-2 bonds
mirror_coordinate: one Givens angle per domain acting on a shared middle TT core
controls: shared outer TT cores plus independent domain middle core
shared TT core plus Mirror domain angles
generic rank-2 PCA over domain middle cores

development.selection_metric: actual serialized bytes, table NRMSE, held-out token lookup NRMSE, code fitting time

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes after fp16 decode
paid_objects: full embedding tables or shared TT cores
domain core factors or Mirror angles

success_gate: Aligned lookup NRMSE <=0.01 and at least 20% fewer bytes than independent domain TT cores; generic PCA matching Mirror means no Mirror-specific claim. Independent cores test domain-private boundary.
failure_gate: Mirror misses lookup quality/storage gate or generic PCA matches/improves; independent domains requiring private cores mark the boundary.
boundaries: Aligned teacher domains are generated from the same Givens core action
No token language modeling, NLL, or transfer training
All methods serialized fp16 and decoded before lookup evaluation
